sm_top.sm: Missiles hit Aden airport while the Saudi-led coalition intercepted a missile headed for Yanbu.
Houthi attacks targeting Riyadh airport resulted in casualties including 13 killed and 17 injured across subsequent updates.
Houthi drone attacks targeted Dammam and the Shaybah oil field, resulting in multiple casualties including deaths and injuries.
An attack in the West Bank left 2 Israeli soldiers and 2 Palestinian gunmen dead.
A retired general discussed U.S. and Israeli planning for a potential attack on Iran.
Russian drone and missile attacks across Ukraine, including a strike near the North Bridge in Kyiv, resulted in at least four deaths.
Sudan denied involvement in a drone strike on an Abyei market that reportedly killed at least 220 people.
Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip resulted in multiple Palestinian deaths and injuries.
Romania blamed Russia after a drone strike sank a cargo ship in the Black Sea, killing one sailor and leaving three missing.
Two men were re-arrested in the UK for assisting Iranian intelligence in a suspected arson plot targeting RAF Fairford.
Iran reported that oil tankers were damaged in the Strait of Hormuz.
The United States withdrew diplomats from Saudi Arabia amid worsening tensions with the Houthis and Iran.
Escalating fighting in Yemen has displaced over 233,000 people and caused a severe humanitarian and hunger crisis.
Poland scrambled fighter jets in response to Russian strikes in western Ukraine.
Ukrainian forces conducted drone strikes against Moscow and a weapons facility in Serpukhov.
Yemeni military forces report ongoing airstrikes against Houthi fighters, with varying casualty figures reported over recent days.
Russian airstrikes hit apartment blocks in Sloviansk, killing six people and leaving others trapped under rubble.
Ukrainian drone attacks disrupted operations at Moscow airports, leading to flight suspensions and air defense interceptions.
The Kremlin warned Germany of new attacks after an attempt to blow up a Ukrainian aircraft in Leipzig.
A tanker was struck by an unknown projectile off the coast of Oman, according to UKMTO.
The Ukrainian Air Force reported that defense forces shot down or neutralized 140 of 176 enemy drones, with hits recorded at 19 locations.
The Saudi coalition intercepted and destroyed a drone launched toward Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province.
Iranian security officials stated that Iran has developed plans to target undersea communications cables in the Gulf if attacked by the US or Israel.
A Russian strike on a market in Lozova killed two people and caused a DTEK power plant to stop generating electricity.
The U.S. is deploying additional warships and Marines to the Middle East amid rising tensions with Iran.
Russia launched a large-scale missile and drone bombardment against Kyiv, resulting in at least 14 deaths and 78 injuries.
A BBC investigation identified multiple RSF attacks on hospitals in El Fasher, Sudan.
A Russian daytime attack on civilian businesses in Chernihiv killed 1 person and injured at least 25 others.
Attacks on a Saudi airport and energy infrastructure left casualties, including one Indian citizen killed.
Washington alerted Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Faleh al-Zaidi to a potential strike on Iran, prompting warnings to domestic armed groups.
Sudan denied responsibility for a drone strike on Amiet Market in Abyei that reportedly killed 220 people.
Israel conducted strikes in southern Lebanon, killing 4,386 people, while a drone was observed flying over Beirut.
Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least 8 people and injured 67 over the past day.
Red Cross reports drone attacks in Sudan are killing hundreds, targeting homes, markets, and displacement camps.
Russian MoD claims drone strikes hit the Novokyivska substation in Hotiv, the Zhytomyrska substation in Zhytomyr, and two dry cargo ships.
The Gaza death toll from Israeli operations rises to 74,498, with over 175,000 injured.
An attack on buses in northern Niger leaves 12 people dead.
Reports indicate the US is preparing to resume large-scale strikes against Iran.
Sudan drone strikes have killed at least 306 people over a three-week period.
Russian air defense forces intercepted dozens of Ukrainian drones over multiple regions.
